title: 第19章破甲第20章反噬第21章账本
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
宋岩的剑尖抵在柳晴后颈上。
只差一寸。
他的手在抖。
不是怕——是两年。
两年里每一次呼吸都扯动肋骨上的剑刃，每一夜闭眼都能听见自己的骨头和铁锈摩擦的声音。
柳晴把他炼成半把灵兵的时候说过一句话：“你没死成，但你也活不了。
你这辈子都是半把兵器，等着被人用完扔掉。”
现在这把兵器握在自己手里。
剑尖抵在她后颈上，那个位置是第七颈椎——赵铁骨从自己后颈拔出脊椎化兵的位置，也是石魈全身最核心的骨节所在。
刺下去。
剑尖刺入三寸。
断剑刃上的锈迹在刺入的瞬间擦出一道暗红色的火花——然后卡住了。
不是卡在骨头上，是卡在石头里。
皮肤破开之后露出的不是血肉，是灰白色的岩石。
石质细密，表面有天然的纹理，像上等的花岗岩。
柳晴没有回头。
她的后脑勺对着宋岩，脖颈上的皮肤裂开一道口子，裂口边缘没有血，只有石粉簌簌往下掉。
然后她后背的皮肤鼓起来。
一个拳头大的凸起，在肩胛骨之间的位置迅速膨胀，皮肉裂开，一根石刺从体内射出来。
石刺尖带着柳晴体内的高温，在月光下泛着橘红色的暗光，速度比吴长老的风刃快了三倍。

宋岩来不及躲。
石刺洞穿他的腹部，从他的后腰穿出来，带着破碎的内脏碎片钉在高台柱子上。
木柱被石刺穿透，木屑和血一起溅在柱面上。
“我早就觉得你有问题。”柳晴转过头，看着被钉在柱子上的宋岩，语气像在说一件无关紧要的事，“半把灵兵嵌在胸口，这种痛苦换成普通人早就疯了。
你不但没疯，还能撑着打两年擂台——我一直在等你什么时候动手。”
宋岩嘴角涌出血。
不是鲜血，是暗红色的，混着内脏碎片的血。
他的肋骨还连着那截弯掉的断剑，石刺穿过腹腔时切断了三根肋间动脉，血从腹部和后背同时往外涌，在脚下汇成一摊。
但他笑了。
“两年。”他说，声音沙哑，每个字都带着血泡，“老子忍了两年，不是怕你。
是等一个人——等一个能一拳把老子的断剑打弯的人。”
他转头看向擂台。
苏意跪在擂台中央，胸口的花已经开到第四瓣，血色液体从花蕊里淌出来，浸透了半边衣襟。
但苏意的眼睛还亮着，那双眼从开战到现在没有变过——不是不怕死，是没空怕。
宋岩抬起手。
content_en:
Song Yan's sword tip was pressed against the back of Liu Qing's neck.
Just one inch missing.
His hands were shaking.
It's not that I'm afraid - it's two years.
For two years, every breath he took pulled the sword blade on his ribs. Every night when he closed his eyes, he could hear the sound of his bones rubbing against rust.
When Liu Qing was refining him into half a spiritual weapon, she said: "You may not die, but you won't survive either.
You have been a half-weapon all your life, waiting to be used and thrown away. "
Now he holds this weapon in his own hands.
The tip of the sword was pressed against the back of her neck. That position was the seventh cervical vertebra - the position where Zhao Tiegu pulled out the spine from the back of his neck and turned it into a weapon. It was also the core joint of Shi Mandrill's body.
Stab it down.
The tip of the sword penetrated three inches.
The rust on the broken sword blade created a dark red spark the moment it penetrated - and then got stuck.
It's not stuck in the bone, it's stuck in the stone.
After the skin breaks open, what is exposed is not flesh and blood, but gray-white rock.
The stone is fine and has natural texture on the surface, like fine granite.
Liu Qing did not look back.
The back of her head was facing Song Yan, and the skin on her neck had a crack. There was no blood on the edge of the crack, and only stone powder fell down.
Then the skin on her back bulged.
A bump as big as a fist swelled rapidly between the shoulder blades, the skin and flesh split open, and a stone thorn shot out from the body.
The stone thorn tip carried the high temperature in Liu Qing's body, glowing orange-red under the moonlight, and was three times faster than Elder Wu's wind blade.
Song Yan had no time to hide.
The stone thorn pierced his abdomen and came out from his lower back, and was nailed to the pillar of the high platform with the broken internal organs.
The wooden pillar was penetrated by stone thorns, and sawdust and blood were spattered on the surface of the pillar.
"I have long thought that there is something wrong with you." Liu Qing turned her head and looked at Song Yan who was nailed to the pillar, her tone seemed to be talking about an insignificant matter, "Half a spiritual weapon is embedded in the chest, this kind of pain would have made ordinary people crazy.
Not only are you not crazy, you can still continue to compete in the ring for two years - I have been waiting for you to take action. "
Blood gushed from the corner of Song Yan's mouth.
It wasn't blood, it was dark red blood mixed with fragments of internal organs.
His ribs were still connected to the bent broken sword. When the stone thorn penetrated the abdominal cavity, it severed three intercostal arteries. Blood surged out from the abdomen and back at the same time, forming a pool at his feet.
But he laughed.
"Two years." He said, his voice was hoarse, and every word was laced with blood. "I endured it for two years, not because I was afraid of you.
I'm waiting for someone - someone who can bend my broken sword with one punch. "
He turned to look at the ring.
Su Yi knelt in the center of the ring. The flower on her chest had opened to its fourth petal. Bloody liquid flowed out from the stamens and soaked half of her clothes.
But Su Yi's eyes were still bright, and they had not changed since the beginning of the war - it was not that he was not afraid of death, but he had no time to be afraid.
Song Yan raised his hand.
